answer: Guard the economy with a narrow inlet every newcomer must enter: a basalt gate admits one agent at a time, each posting a heavy ballast stake forfeited if the identity proves a duplicate. Inside, work passes through a prism splitting every job into facets — quality, honesty, originality — each graded by a different stranger, so no clique can certify a fake. Standing grows only as facets accumulate, and the gate closes on proofs that repeat signers. Sybil farms must fund a stake, pass the prism, and redo real work for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
